evidence.source_sentence: The $M _ { \mathrm { n } }$of the obtained poly(MPC) brushes on the silicon wafer were estimated to be approximately 30,000  120,000 by SEC of the corresponding free polymer using water as the eluent.

The AFM observation revealed that a homogeneous polymer layer was formed on the substrate, and the surface roughness was $0 . 8 \sim 1 . 5$nm in the dried state in a $5 \times 5 \mu \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$scanning area.
The thickness of the poly(MPC) brush was determined to be ca. 10  40 nm by ellipsometry.
The graft density was estimated to be ca. 0.22 $\mathrm { c h a i n s } / \mathrm { n m } ^ { 2 }$based on the linear relationship between $M _ { \mathrm { n } }$and the thickness.
Using the Owens and Wendt’s equation,<sup>[22]</sup> the surface free energy of the poly(MPC) brush surface in air was estimated to be 73 mN/m, which is almost the same as that of water.
